findings.location: source.html, final paragraph of Grandma Otto’s speech
findings.source_quote: “God made you the way you are for a reason, Jamin. He made Kenny the way he is for a reason.”
findings.suggested_fix: “上帝造你成为现在的样子自有祂的理由，Jamin。祂造 Kenny 成为现在的样子也自有祂的理由。”
findings.translation_quote: “上帝按着祂的旨意造就了你的样子，Jamin。祂按着祂的旨意造就了 Kenny 的样子。”

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “Jamin went to the wash house”
findings.source_quote: “Jamin went to the wash house and scrubbed his hands.”
findings.suggested_fix: 将“洗手房”改为“洗涤间”或符合上下文的其他译法，例如：“Jamin 去洗涤间把手洗干净。”

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “Jamin.” It was Grandma
findings.source_quote: “A heavy comforter lay on her shoulders.”
findings.suggested_fix: 将“安慰被”改为“厚厚的被子”或“厚厚的棉被”，例如：“她肩上披着一床厚厚的被子。”
findings.translation_quote: “一床厚厚的安慰被披在她肩上。”
